lead.title: Tandem Health extends its AI clinical documentation to more than ten specialties at Rotterdam's Maasstad Ziekenhuis
lead.deck: Tandem's assistant listens to the consultation and drafts a structured clinical note, which the physician reviews, edits and approves before it enters the patient record; the Rotterdam hospital, part of the Santeon group (seven hospitals) and the Coöperatie Zorg op Zuid, now uses it across more than ten specialties, with more than 20,000 consultations already supported according to the hospital. For the former Juvoly, CE-marked under the MDR, certified to ISO 13485, ISO 42001 and BSI C5 and claiming 10,000 care organisations in 14 countries, it shows that after its $100M raise led in September by EQT's Scaleup Europe Fund, the European AI scribe battle is now fought at whole-hospital scale, with more than 130 patient record systems already connected across Europe.

milestone.title: Italy's AMD diabetologists unveil a "kidney digital twin" that predicts three-year risk of chronic kidney disease
milestone.summary: Presented at the 13th national congress of the AMD Foundation in Trieste, the model, built with Rita Zilich (Mix-x), relies on a Logic Learning Machine, an explainable AI with readable decision rules, trained on data from more than 136,000 patients in the Annali AMD database (1.5 million people with type 2 diabetes followed from 2010 to 2023). It estimates the risk of chronic kidney failure and simulates how glomerular filtration rate evolves with or without SGLT2 inhibitors; first analyses show 89% accuracy for kidney failure and 79% for albuminuria.
milestone.why: Chronic kidney disease affects about half of people with type 2 diabetes: a tool that simulates a treatment's benefit before prescribing moves the digital twin from the lab to the consultation room. Next step: a web app for clinicians, to be tested in a group of diabetes centres, after a special mention at the Politecnico di Milano's 2026 Premio Innovazione Digitale in Sanità.

brefsEurope.title: Kirin makes Ireland's FoodMarble, which measures gut fermentation through breath, the first investment of its KIRIN VENTURES fund
brefsEurope.summary: Announced on November 20 (for a stake dated September 30, amount undisclosed), the deal targets the digestive health platform founded in 2015 and led by Aonghus Shortt: a pocket breath analyser and an app that match gases produced by gut fermentation with meal and symptom logs. Kirin wants to combine this data with its fermentation and microbiome expertise to co-create services in Japan, while FoodMarble plans to expand its AI-driven self-care features.

brefsEurope.title: InterSystems launches IntelliCare in Italy, its AI-native hospital information system CE-marked as Class IIa
brefsEurope.summary: The successor to TrakCare (more than 600 hospitals in 29 countries, 14 of them in Italy) embeds an ambient-voice AI scribe that structures the note in the record, prepares test orders and visit reports and lets nurses dictate handovers, with the clinician keeping the final decision. Already adopted in Indonesia, the UAE and Saudi Arabia, it will be showcased at the Forum Risk Management in Arezzo (Nov 24-27): a comparable for scribe startups, now that EHR vendors build the feature in natively.

brefsEurope.title: Philips launches Advanced Image Insights, a cloud platform orchestrating third-party imaging AI inside the radiologist's workflow
brefsEurope.summary: Announced ahead of RSNA 2026, the AWS-hosted SaaS combines Philips' advanced visualisation applications with centralised management of third-party AI algorithms, each keeping its intended use and regulatory status; connected to the HealthSuite Imaging PACS, it can for instance run incidental pulmonary embolism detection and lung nodule analysis in parallel on the same chest CT, then feed results into a structured report. A sign that distribution for radiology AI startups runs through the big OEMs' marketplaces.

brefsEurope.title: A decree seats France's new directorate for health research, innovation and digital on six bodies, including the CEPS
brefsEurope.summary: Operational since November 1, the DGRINES, which merges the digital health delegation, most of the Agence de l'innovation en santé and the "article 51" mission, takes over the DNS seats at the Conférence nationale de santé, the ARS steering council and the Fmis committee, and replaces the DGOS on the Comité économique des produits de santé. Its director general Lise Alter will therefore sit where health product prices, digital devices included, are negotiated.

brefsEurope.title: France renews €4.74M to fund dedicated digital health posts in its regional health agencies
brefsEurope.summary: An order renews this allocation from the Fonds pour la modernisation et l'investissement en santé for the posts driving the Ségur numérique, the promotion of Mon espace santé and cybersecurity in the regions; the largest envelopes (€303,800 each) go to Hauts-de-France, Martinique, Mayotte and Pays de la Loire, the smallest (€178,800) to La Réunion. Regional relays are maintained, which matters for vendors that must win adoption facility by facility.

brefsEurope.title: ABN AMRO warns that Dutch care organisations lagging on AI will slip into the red
brefsEurope.summary: According to the bank's sector report published on November 19, only one care organisation in eight uses speech recognition for documentation, which can cut documentation time by 10%; the sector's caution stems from data protection, limited experience, misdiagnosis risk and unclear liability. Protected budgets limit the pressure for now, but room to invest should shrink after next year, and those who have not automated will fall behind once competitors have lowered their costs.

brefsIntl.title: Function Health adds personalised action plans, specialist booking and $340 family plans
brefsIntl.summary: The lab-testing platform (160+ tests a year) now generates, through its Medical Intelligence Lab, prioritised action plans reviewed by clinicians, lets members book an in-network specialist, offers supplements via SuppCo (acquired in May) and at-home blood draws with Getlabs at $149. A comparable for European consumer preventive-health players, who are also trying to move from one-off check-ups to ongoing subscriptions.

word.definition: A digital representation of a patient, an organ or a disease, built from their data and models, that simulates how it will evolve and respond to treatment before acting on the real patient.

parts.label: Data
parts.role: the patient's or a cohort's tests, imaging, lab results and history

parts.label: Model
parts.role: the AI or physics-based simulation that reproduces the organ or disease

parts.label: Scenarios
parts.role: treatment options tested virtually to compare their effects

how.t: The model is built from the patient's data (CT, MRI, lab results) or trained on large cohorts, such as the 136,000 patients AMD used for its kidney twin.
The twin projects how the organ or disease evolves and tests scenarios: with or without treatment, or a device's performance across a virtual population.
The clinician or manufacturer relies on these forecasts to choose a strategy, plan a procedure or flag at-risk patients, with the decision remaining human.

word.why: The European Commission has invested more than €100M in its Virtual Human Twins initiative, with a dedicated platform funded by the Digital Europe programme, and the first twins are moving from labs into the consultation room. For a VC the appeal is twofold: decision-support tools that personalise treatment, and "virtual" trials that cut the cost and risk of device development, two markets where value concentrates in data and clinical validation.

startups.name: adsilico
startups.use: University of Leeds spinout whose Virtual Chimera technology uses AI to generate virtual hearts and vessels for testing medical devices; £10M Series A led by PXN Ventures in October 2026

startups.name: inHEART
startups.use: AI-generated digital twin of the heart built from CT or MRI scans to plan cardiac ablations; raised $11M to accelerate commercialisation of its software

startups.name: Integratome
startups.use: SaaS platform that assembles questionnaires, measurements and lab results into a digital health twin (73 conditions modelled) to prepare check-ups, with a simulator of lifestyle-change effects
